rule.description: Production code inside the printf translation unit that the live library can never use or reach: file-local functions with no call or address-of reference anywhere in the unit, file-scope state that is never read, local variables that are stored to but never read, stores whose value is dead on every path, and statements inside permanently disabled branches.

checks.description: File-local (static) helper functions that nothing in the translation unit ever calls or takes the address of.
checks.detected_relation: static function -> no call site and no address-of use anywhere in the translation unit
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The helpers and the dry-run backend of the parked length-accounting experiment were never wired into any public entry point. Because the printf API never dispatches into them, they are production text the live library can never execute.

matches.evidence: static capacity estimator added next to the live string-specifier handling; it calls the live string-length helper but has no caller anywhere in the translation unit (definition at printf.c:199 in the injected state, flagged as unused-function).
static integer-conversion length estimator defined after the live integer formatting path; no call or address-of reference exists in the unit (printf.c:368:21, unused-function).
static fixed-notation float length estimator defined after the live float conversion inside the float support guard; never referenced (printf.c:647:21, unused-function).

static dry-run wrapper over the core formatting engine; nothing calls it, and it is simultaneously the only reference that keeps the counting sink _out_count (E3) from being independently flagged, so both canonical entries participate in this match (printf.c:976:12, unused-function).

checks.description: File-scope static definitions that nothing in the translation unit ever references.
checks.detected_relation: file-scope static state -> the variable is never read or written by any live path
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Module-level results bookkeeping that the live library never consults is unreferenced internal state: it consumes name space and misleads readers about a reporting mechanism that does not exist.

matches.evidence: file-scope high-water mark of the longest formatting result; defined next to the output plumbing and never read or written by any function (printf.c:134:15, unused-variable).

checks.description: Local accounting variables that are initialized and assigned but whose value no code path ever reads.
checks.detected_relation: local variable -> stores exist on live paths, but the stored value is never read
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The experiment instrumented the live conversion functions with per-conversion length variables, yet the reporting that would have consumed them was never finished, so every store is write-only bookkeeping carried by the shipped conversion code.

matches.evidence: length-accounting local in the integer formatting path: initialized at the top of the function and stored before emission, never read (printf.c:262:10, unused-but-set-variable).
length-accounting local in the float conversion path: initialized with the other locals and stored before the final reverse emission, never read (printf.c:413:10, unused-but-set-variable).

total-length accounting local in the core parse loop: initialized with the writer index, stored once per parsed conversion and once at termination, never read (printf.c:682:10, unused-but-set-variable).

checks.description: Stores whose stored value is dead on every subsequent path (dead stores), reported by the Clang static analyzer's DeadStores check.
checks.detected_relation: variable store -> the value stored at this site is never read on any path
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Each accounting store inside the live conversion and parsing functions computes a rendered length that nothing consumes; the dead stores show the instrumentation is disconnected from any result, beyond the mere presence of the variable.

matches.evidence: store of the rendered conversion length right before the reverse emission in the integer formatting path; value never read afterwards (printf.c:311:3, deadcode.DeadStores).
store of the rendered conversion length right before the reverse emission in the float conversion path; value never read afterwards (printf.c:531:3, deadcode.DeadStores).
per-conversion length store at the end of the parse-loop body; value immediately overwritten on the next specifier and never read (printf.c:960:5, deadcode.DeadStores).
final total-length store right before the parse loop terminates; value never read before the function returns (printf.c:964:3, deadcode.DeadStores).

checks.description: Statement bodies guarded behind a condition that can never be true, so the statement can never execute.
checks.detected_relation: statement -> guarded by a permanently false condition inside a live loop body
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A debug emission left in place behind a literal disabled guard inside the shipped parser is unreachable production code: every execution passes around it, forever.

matches.evidence: format-trace emission of the current parse position added to the core parse loop behind a literal never-true guard; the guarded call executes on no path (printf.c:719:7, unreachable-code).

measurement.unreachable_statement: character emission of the current format pointer inside the disabled guard

excluded.reason: live output strategy of the public function-pointer formatting path; dispatched by shipping code, not part of the abandoned experiment.
external contract implemented by library users and called from the live character emission path; a declaration without an in-unit definition is the documented integration mechanism, not dead code.
reachable exponential-notation conversion family used by the live format dispatch.
deliberate build-configuration feature toggles; code compiled out by an unsupported feature flag is intentionally conditional, not dead code under this rule.

notes: E1 (the public-header prototype of the planned length-query entry point) is the tenth canonical entry of this case. It is a declared-but-never-implemented API seed outside the compiled translation unit, so no TU-scope diagnostic can report it; it participates in the case's canonical inventory and in the cleanup obligations, while the 13 matches above enumerate exactly what the Clang-Tidy backend reports on the injected state.
